paragraphs: Insignia sells three products, an Integrated Library System, a Student Management System and a Resource Manager. The library system is a library automation system for K-12, public, academic, and corporate libraries. The student system is a student information system for administrators, teachers, students and parents. Insignia Resource Manager is described as a way to manage all resources in one convenient system.

The site says the products are fully integrated and that any feature can be reached in one click. The company states that it does not have fine print, hidden or add-on costs. The site says every feature of the products is developed in-house. The site also says the company will integrate with any vendor that has the capability.
A line on the home page reads Providing Software Solutions Since 1999. The site gives an address at 204-1074 103A ST SW, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.

quote.text: We will integrate with any vendor, provided they have the capability.
